biggest_catch: Zero guaranteed supporters: you must bring your own audience, the 0% platform fee applies only to one-time tips when you opt out of the default Standard/Contributor status, and normal PayPal/Stripe processing fees always apply.
catches: 0% service fee only on one-time tips (and only with the opt-out from the default status); memberships, shop sales, and commissions carry ~5% on the free plan.
Payment-processing fees (PayPal/Stripe) apply to every transaction regardless of plan.
A paid plan (~$12/month) removes Ko-fi's service fees entirely — worth it only if your volume exceeds the free-plan cut.
No audience, no tips: Ko-fi is a payment page, not a discovery engine — $0 is the default outcome.

steps: Create a free Ko-fi page and connect your PayPal or Stripe account.
Decide your status: accept the default Standard/Contributor status or opt out so one-time tips carry a 0% service fee.
Share your Ko-fi link with your audience — supporters tip or buy directly.
If you sell memberships, shop items, or commissions, account for the ~5% Ko-fi fee on the free plan (or consider the paid plan to remove it).
Receive funds directly in your connected PayPal/Stripe account as they are paid.
